justifications.durability: the specimen fails if the exclusion regresses — replacing _prose_text with the visible-text reader in reckon/doccheck.py yields two md-bold findings on the specimen against the asserted one — and the live comparison trips if a verbatim pair starts reporting as prose, though nothing in the file fails if a later edit re-binds an assertion to the living document.

justifications.fit: the change reuses the file's own _bare/_codes helpers and sentence-named tests, names its fixtures by mechanism (QUOTED_SPECIMEN at :25, PROSE_SPECIMEN beside it), carries no plan or stage labels, and is clean under ruff check and ruff format --check.
